rules.sentence: Identify early clinical and laboratory signs that warrant diagnostic evaluation and referral to specialty care.
Assess the characteristic physical findings and multisystem involvement in patients with Alagille syndrome.
Implement evidence-based medical therapies, including nutritional optimization, pruritus management, and bile acid–modifying treatments, to improve patient outcomes.
The hallmark feature is the paucity of interlobular bile ducts, leading to chronic cholestasis.
This typically presents in the first 3 months of life with jaundice, pruritus, and elevated gamma-glutamyltransferase levels.
